name: Couchbase, Inc.
origin_detail: Formed in 2011 by merging Membase Inc. (formerly NorthScale, built around memcached) with CouchOne, the company of Apache CouchDB creator Damien Katz; based in Santa Clara, California.
openness_notes: Open core: Community Edition source historically Apache-2.0, with a proprietary Enterprise Edition and the Capella cloud. A move of Couchbase Server source to BSL 1.1 around 2021 is recalled but not verified; if confirmed, the current level is 1. Current level left null until checked.
